newsitem.title: USA: BW/IP sees growth from higher bookings.
newsitem.headline: BW/IP sees growth from higher bookings.

text.p: BW/IP Inc, the parent company of BW/IP International Inc, said on Tuesday that higher bookings from recent quarters should result in higher sales and net income for the rest of 1997.
"Our pattern over the last several years has beem a slow first quarter followed by three stronger ones," company Chairman Bernard Rethore said in a statement.

"In spite of the lower shipments in the first quarter, earnings results were somewhat better than expected and provide a good foundation for producing double-digit earnings growth over the remainder of the year," he added.
"Recent acquisitions added bookings that allowed us to set this quarter's record and should help us to sustain a solidly higher run rate in 1997," he said.
BW/IP reported net income per share of $0.24 for the
first quarter, compared with $0.25 for the same period the year before.
BW/IP supplies fluid transfer and control equipment, systems and services.
